svg.text: Programming USB-C, data-line protection and nonvolatile boot interfaces
35 × 35 mm | 4-layer PCB | Hardware prototype — assembly/firmware/bench qualification pending
Separate 5.1 kΩ CC pull-downs; duplicated D+/D− contacts
Resistive divider to MCU; fixed 5 V input only
Boot contact and WCH DCK/DIO are retained
USB full-speed D+/D− route directly to CH32X035.
Debug interface is shown on Controller sheet 03.
